scientific.integrity: The source-form diffGrad recurrence is linearized at its zero reference orbit. The nonconstant friction term is second order because it multiplies the first moment; the second-moment denominator differs from its epsilon floor only by a higher-order term. Jury conditions on the exact limiting two-state block give the stated frontier.
limitations: The theorem is deterministic, scalar, and local.
The bias-corrected recurrence is nonautonomous; the result is a strict asymptotic local-stability statement.
No claim is made at the unit-root equality boundary.
Global cycles or nonlinear behavior outside the local regime are not classified.

title: Exact epsilon-floor local stability law for diffGrad
